limits: Authored contracts do not establish good visual design.
Paint isolation temporarily changes inline visibility and restores it; pseudo-elements, filters, blending and dynamic state require inspection.
Raster measurements depend on browser, font, DPR and threshold. Integer coordinates are not required; do not snap all values to whole pixels.
No global collision, occlusion, accessibility or beauty guarantee. Inspect natural-size crops before enlarged raster evidence.
